leagues.name: UCI Women's WorldTour (women's road cycling)
notes: 14 UCI Women's WorldTeams granted 2026-2028 licences by the UCI Licence Commission (UCI press release, 2026-2028 cycle).
Every team is named after a sponsor; names change with sponsors.
Sponsor placement is mapped to the schema's front/back/sleeve/shorts/partner values from 'team title/name' and 'jersey'.
Mid-season rename: UAE Team ADQ became UAE Team L'IMAD on 1 August 2026 after ADQ was absorbed into L'IMAD; the UCI licence list still shows UAE Team ADQ (Cyclingnews, 2026-07-27).

owners.name: L'IMAD (Abu Dhabi sovereign investor, formerly ADQ)
owners.via: Sovereign investor of the Government of Abu Dhabi; absorbed ADQ in 2026; chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed (The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05)
owners.note: UAE Team L'IMAD sponsor page: 'L'IMAD is a sovereign investor of the Government of Abu Dhabi.' Cyclingnews (2026-07-27): Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund reportedly worth about $300bn, chaired by Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan; ADQ absorbed into L'IMAD. The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) says the fund is chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed. Chair accounts differ between sources.

owners.name: WorxInvest
owners.note: Belgian holding company started in 2018 as SD Worx's investment arm; parent of SD Worx (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

owners.name: Ageas
owners.note: Belgium's largest insurer, listed on Euronext Brussels; owns 75% of AG Insurance, the other 25% held by BNP Paribas Fortis (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

owners.name: Arpa Industriale
owners.note: Italian manufacturer of high-pressure laminate; owner of the Fenix brand used as Fenix-Premier Tech's title sponsor (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

owners.name: Optum
owners.note: US health-services arm of UnitedHealth Group; Human Powered Health is described as a subsidiary of Optum (The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05).

sponsors.name: L'IMAD
sponsors.note: Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund (formerly ADQ, absorbed into L'IMAD); title sponsor of UAE Team L'IMAD from 1 August 2026.

sponsors.name: NMDC Group
sponsors.note: Abu Dhabi dredging/energy EPC group; main sponsor of UAE Team L'IMAD. Ownership not verified from a primary source.

sponsors.name: IHC (International Holding Company)
sponsors.note: Abu Dhabi listed holding company; main sponsor of UAE Team L'IMAD. Reuses normalized owner id international-holding-company.

sponsors.name: Analog
sponsors.note: Adaptive intelligence/technology company; official technology sponsor of UAE Team ADQ/L'IMAD. The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) says Analog is owned by G42 (normalized sponsor id g42, Mubadala-backed).

sponsors.name: MyWhoosh
sponsors.note: Indoor cycling app; main sponsor of UAE Team L'IMAD. Ownership not found.

sponsors.name: Oatly
sponsors.note: Swedish oat-drink maker listed on the New York Stock Exchange; co-title sponsor of EF Education-Oatly (Cyclist, 2026-07-14; EF partner page).

sponsors.name: Suez
sponsors.note: French water and waste utility listed on Euronext Paris/Brussels; co-title sponsor of FDJ United-Suez (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

sponsors.name: SD Worx
sponsors.note: Belgian HR/payroll services company; title sponsor of Team SD Worx-Protime.

sponsors.name: Protime
sponsors.note: Time-registration brand belonging to the SD Worx group; co-title sponsor of Team SD Worx-Protime (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

sponsors.name: Canyon
sponsors.note: German bike brand; title sponsor of Canyon//SRAM (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

sponsors.name: SRAM
sponsors.note: Chicago-based component manufacturer; co-title sponsor of Canyon//SRAM (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

sponsors.name: AG Insurance
sponsors.note: Belgian insurer founded 1824, 75% owned by Ageas, 25% by BNP Paribas Fortis; title sponsor of AG Insurance-Soudal (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

sponsors.name: Fenix
sponsors.note: Surface-material brand of Italy's Arpa Industriale; title sponsor of Fenix-Premier Tech (Cyclist, 2026-07-14).

sponsors.name: Human Powered Health
sponsors.note: US sports-science/health company; title sponsor of the Human Powered Health Women's WorldTeam. The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) describes it as a subsidiary of Optum, part of UnitedHealth Group.

sponsors.name: Liv
sponsors.note: Women's bike brand of Giant Bicycles; co-title sponsor of Liv AlUla Jayco (Cyclist, 2026-07-14: 'Liv Cycling is the women's arm of Giant Bicycles'; The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05). Giant's ownership not traced.

sponsors.name: Specialized
sponsors.note: US bike manufacturer; premium partner of Team SD Worx-Protime (team partners page). Not state-linked.

proposedRatings.reasoning: L'IMAD is 'a sovereign investor of the Government of Abu Dhabi' (team sponsor page), the absorbed former ADQ; Cyclingnews (2026-07-27) calls it an Abu Dhabi sovereign wealth fund reportedly worth about $300bn. Same Abu Dhabi state money as the men's team's XRG/ADNOC: a 2024 mass trial of 43 activists with life sentences, upheld by the Federal Supreme Court in March 2025 (both claims already in normalized). serious.

AlUla (Experience AlUla) is run by the Royal Commission for AlUla, 'an arm of the Saudi Arabian government' (Australian Human Rights Institute, 2022-12); the UNSW Institute's director called the partnership sportswashing. Carries the Saudi state's record (a record 345 executions in 2024, claim saudi-executions-2024 already in normalized). serious, matching the men's file's rating of the same sponsor.

IHC is an Abu Dhabi listed holding company chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed (ruling family; normalized owner entry and claim ihc-record note it is royal-family-linked but listed, not a state body). UAE state-adjacent money on the women's team jersey; concern rather than serious because the link is indirect.

FDJ is the French national lottery; the French state remains its largest shareholder after the 2019 privatisation (Cyclist, 2026-07-14). France's civic-space/policing record fits concern (claim france-hrw-record already in normalized); matches the men's file's rating of FDJ.

unsourced: Individual jersey placements (front/back/sleeve) for non-title sponsors are not documented: women's teams publish partner lists but not jersey maps, so only title sponsors are placed 'front' and others 'partner'; sponsorsComplete is false for every kit.

L'IMAD's chairman: Cyclingnews (2026-07-27) says Crown Prince Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan; The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) says the fund is chaired by Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed. Both opened; the accounts were not reconciled.
NMDC Group's ownership (ADQ/L'IMAD stake) could not be verified: nmdcgroup.com did not resolve and adq.ae portfolio page could not be fetched; the team sponsor page describes the business only.
Analog's ownership: The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) says Analog is an IT company owned by G42; no primary corporate filing opened, so ownerId left null (G42 exists as a normalized sponsor id).
MyWhoosh ownership not found; the team page describes the product only.

Zondacrypto conflict: the UCI 2026 licence list (opened) still registers the team as Canyon//SRAM ZONDACRYPTO, but Cyclist (2026-07-14) and The Inner Ring (2026-08-05) both report zondacrypto was dropped in 2026 after the Polish exchange 'vanished taking some people's savings'; zondacrypto.com did not load (HTTP 522). Recorded as a change rather than a sponsor.
AG Insurance-Soudal's team website (aginsurancesoudalteam.be) did not load; AG Insurance/Soudal placements rest on the Cyclist 2026-07-14 explainer and the UCI registration name.
Human Powered Health: The Inner Ring describes it as a subsidiary of Optum (UnitedHealth Group); no primary corporate filing opened for the Optum parent link, owner entry marked accordingly.

Specialized, and SD Worx-Protime's premium partners (Dolmans Landscaping Group, Finvision, BMW Le Couter), are listed on the team partners page but only Specialized was given a placement; the others are not yet sponsors in the data.
The UCI press release page shows no publication date (footer copyright 2026 only).

Kit 'change' badges: the UAE Team ADQ -> L'IMAD rename (1 Aug 2026) and Canyon//SRAM dropping zondacrypto mid-2026 are recorded in kit summaries and here rather than as change badges, because 'worse/better' kinds do not fit a neutral rename/sponsor exit.
